title: Similar sites of any list of domains

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Domains, URLs or e-mail addresses, one per line. You get the sites most like each of them.

maxReferrersPerDomain.title: Similar sites per domain
maxReferrersPerDomain.description: How many similar sites to return for each domain, most similar first (up to 1,000).

minAuthority.title: Minimum Open Authority
minAuthority.description: Return only similar sites scoring at least this (0-100). 0 = all of them.

maxItems.title: Max rows
maxItems.description: Maximum rows to return (and pay for).
